str.name: strength
str.desc: Strength determines bash damage. For example, an ability dealing 50% Bash deals damage equal to 50% of your Strength.

dex.name: dexterity
dex.desc: Each point of dexterity improves all skill roll chances by 1%.

itl.name: intelligence
itl.desc: Each point of intelligence reduces ability cooldowns by 1%.

agi.name: agility
agi.desc: Agility determines your base movement speed.

adrenaline.desc: When you are injured, gain +2 to all combat stats for a short time.

carnivore.desc: You can only eat meat, but you can also eat right out of corpses.

herbivore.desc: You can only eat plants, but you can also eat shrubs and flowers.

antennae.quote: Antennaes grow out of your head!
antennae.desc: You have a pair of antennae. These let you observe tiles outside of your vision.

antlers.quote: Antlers protrude from your skull! OUCH!
antlers.desc: You have a set of antlers. Grants you [Ram].

slicers.quote: Something sharp is growing out of your back!
slicers.desc: You have a pair of long, sharp appendages growing out of your back. Grants [Double Slice].

barkskin.desc: You have thick, rough warts covering your body. +1 Armor.

beak.desc: You have a large beak for a mouth. Grants you [Peck].

big ears.desc: You have large rodent ears. Sound gives you vision.

cat ears.desc: You have a pair of cat ears. You can hear things from double the distance away.

claws.desc: You have sharp claws. Grants you [Swipe].

sharp eyes.desc: You have sharp eyes. Grants you +1 Perception.

evil eyes.desc: Your eyes have turned red. Gives you permanent night vision.

white fur.quote: You start growing hair out of your body...
white fur.desc: You have white fur covering your body. +1 Resistance.

hooves.desc: You have hooves for feet! +1 Agility.

mandibles.desc: You have giant, intimidating mandibles covering your face. Grants you [Dig Down].

muzzle.quote: You get a bad cramp on your mouth.
muzzle.desc: You have muzzles like a rat. You can eat rotten food.

scales.quote: You start growing weird warts on your skin...

shell.quote: You start growing a giant shell on your back...
shell.desc: There is a giant shell on your back. Grants you [Harden].

fangs.desc: You have a pair of sharp fangs! You lifesteal on attack, but you cannot heal naturally.

undead.desc: You are undead. You don't need to eat or drink.

tail.desc: You have a short tail. +1 Dexterity.

long tail.desc: You have a long tail. +1 Dexterity, grants [Tail Whip].

whiskers.desc: You have long whiskers. Grants you [Deep Sense].

bat wings.quote: Something ruptures out of your back! OUCH!
bat wings.desc: You have large bat wings. Grants you [Quick Flight].

bird wings.quote: Something ruptures out of your back! OUCH!
bird wings.desc: You have large bird wings. Grants you [Flight].

insect wings.quote: Something grows out of your back.
